name: push_stroller
text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a baby stroller, with both hands continuously on the stroller handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.
